test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All birds are parrots.

No parrot is a crow.

Some owls are crows.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some parrots are owls.

II. No crow is a bird.

III. No owl is a bird.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Here, we are given some statements and we need to check which conclusion are true.

First we will see the venn diagram of each statements by one by:

1) All birds are parrots:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72b6fbf74982b79bba4f3a0b79e7f1d596cd7166f1c6b0b577f5a2b674c064bb.png] 

2) No parrot is a crow:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0863ace457094db5b1fd76021b5a280331c0587decea4ad051ee5fb1cb5a8ecb.png] 

3) Some owls are crows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed8ef0d3eac21508cacd2c8b8d05d3e8721040dc6d84367e19e57302467f1d17.png] 

Thus, combining all the statements, we will get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45b395b670ad7cf7cf21fe9000240389ea1639343cb52e1ac68b9c5031ac051e.png] 

Next, we will see the conclusion:

1) Some parrots are owls: Since they have not mentioned any relation between parrots and owls. This is not true.

2) No crow is a bird: From the above figure, we can say that, this is true. 

3) No owl is a bird: Since they have not mentioned any relation between parrots and owls. This is not true.

Hence, only conclusion 2 follows.
